log: The night the grid failed, the machines came looking for power.
We left the grid to them, and grew our own light.
By day they sleep. We let them.
Every panel-tender gets a guide. You got Marla.
MARLA: Up, Potts. Sun is wasting.

Your job: panel-tender Keep the panels and devices working. Bring food and essentials back from the old settlement. Hold a house against the Gloom until dawn. Work with your guide: Marla the Scout. Got it (Enter)
